Regressions all green: /@captainjane renders HandleProfile (Captain Jane, @captainjane, recent posts), /notarealroute redirects to /, Onboarding shows 10 market chips + 7 reason chips + 3 handle-autofill chips (click fills handle-input and shows '@x is available ✓'), the 429 hint renders as data-testid='handle-availability-throttled' in amber-600 ('Too many checks — try again in a moment.') once /api/handle/available starts 429-ing (confirmed 429 after ~23 rapid calls), and AdminContact shadcn Select opens with 3 template options that populate the textarea.

critical.issue: The 'atomic $inc claim' is not a claim. The filter {id, replies:{$elemMatch:{id, delivered:false}}} still matches after another worker has already incremented retry_count, so both runs get modified_count==1 and both send. asyncio.gather of two runs on ONE undelivered reply -> 2 send_email calls and retry_count=2. Overlapping/misfired cron runs (misfire_grace_time=1800) will duplicate customer emails and burn the 5-retry budget twice as fast.

minor.issue: next_run() only reports events_weekly_sync/expiring_nightly/sunday_digest — the new contact_reply_retry (and monday_admin_report_digest) jobs are invisible to any admin scheduler-status surface.

No per-reply backoff: every eligible reply is retried on every 3h tick regardless of last_retry_at, so a hard-failing address burns all 5 retries within 15h with no escalation/alert, and there is no counter/log of permanently-dead replies (retry_count==5).

ui_bugs.issue: The initial GET /boat-pros/mine has no error state — on failure (e.g. 401 during session hand-off) it silently does setPhotos([]), and the very next upload PATCHes a 1-element array that WIPES the pro's existing gallery server-side. Reproduced: with the cookie applied late the uploader showed 0 slots while mongo had 3 photos, and the upload replaced all 3.

issues: data-testid='stripe-test-hint' uses text-slate-400 on white (~2.8:1) — below WCAG AA 4.5:1; use text-slate-500/600.

The hint duplicates the amber banner almost verbatim ('Use card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date, any CVC.' appears twice on the same screen) — consider shortening the hint to 'Test mode — card 4242…' or dropping the banner's card copy.
Sonner toasts still render top-center and overlay the page heading — carried over from iter45/46, cosmetic.

action_items: Make the retry claim a real CAS: include the observed retry_count in the $elemMatch (e.g. one-time normalisation $set replies.$[].retry_count=0, then filter {id: r.id, delivered:false, retry_count: rc} and $inc) — or claim on a last_retry_at cutoff. Current $inc-only filter allows concurrent double-sends (test_iter47_phase_u.py::TestContactReplyRetryJob).

Give ProPhotosUploader a load/error state: if GET /boat-pros/mine fails, disable the Add-photos input and surface an error instead of defaulting photos to [] (prevents wiping an existing gallery on the next PATCH).
Raise the /pricing stripe-test-hint contrast (text-slate-400 -> text-slate-500/600) and de-duplicate the 4242 copy between banner and hint.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduler.py: the $inc-only 'claim' in _contact_reply_retry_job does not exclude an already-claimed reply — the guarding predicate must change with the write (CAS on retry_count or last_retry_at). Also worth logging retry_count==5 give-ups.

imageCompress.js: the cap ladder re-runs all 6 qualities at 1200 and 900 even when the source long edge is already <= 900, i.e. up to 18 identical toBlob encodes for a small uncompressible file. Skip a cap when Math.max(w,h) <= previous cap.
scheduler.py is 480 lines and mixes 5 unrelated cron jobs; consider splitting into scheduler/jobs/*.py before it crosses 700.
ProPhotosUploader.jsx doc comment is stale — it still says 'long-edge capped at 1600px', not the new [1600,1200,900] ladder.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the retry double-send: an atomic claim requires the write to invalidate its own filter. `update_one({'id': msg.id, 'replies': {'$elemMatch': {'id': r.id, 'delivered': False}}}, {'$inc': {'replies.$.retry_count': 1}, '$set': {'replies.$.last_retry_at': now}})` mutates retry_count/last_retry_at but predicates only on delivered:false, which stays false until AFTER send_email returns. Two overlapping runs therefore both satisfy the filter, both get modified_count==1, and both send. Reproduction: seed one contact_messages doc with replies:[{delivered:false, retry_count:0}], patch mailer.send_email to an async fn that sleeps 250 ms and returns {'status':'ok'}, then `await asyncio.gather(_contact_reply_retry_job(db), _contact_reply_retry_job(db))` -> 2 sends, retry_count 2. Mitigation: compare-and-swap on the value just read (filter on retry_count == rc, after normalising the missing-field case) or claim on `last_retry_at` < now - lease.
